description: Model-specific generation limits. Values marked dynamic are read from the model files at runtime and take precedence over the declared defaults; the declared values are the fallback when the files are not readable.

context_tokens_source.note: The autoregressive stage refuses prefix + budget beyond this; yue2.sampling.generate_tokens raises rather than truncating.

latent_frame_rate_source.note: 48000 / 1920 = 25 codec tokens per second of audio, one token per latent frame.

yue2.capability_note: yue2-infer 0.1.6 exposes plan/generate_semantic/synthesize/decode and no continuation, resume or audio-prefix entry point. A song is produced in one autoregressive pass, so the context window is a hard ceiling on its length and cannot be extended by chunking.
